errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the main grouping of the chart which is based on the 'Възможност за избор на работно място' (Possibility to choose a workplace), indicated by the panels 'НЕ' (NO) and 'ДА' (YES).

errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа категориите „От вкъщи“, „От офис“ и „От вкъщи“.
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect and incomplete description of the x-axis. The chart is divided into two panels ('НЕ' and 'ДА'), each containing the categories 'От вкъщи' and 'От офиса'. The description lists them sequentially and misses the second 'От офиса' category, failing to capture the grouped structure.
The highest value shown in the chart, for the 'От офис' category in the 'ДА' group, is approximately 41, not 46.
This incorrectly interprets the main grouping of the chart. The groups 'НЕ' (NO) and 'ДА' (YES) refer to the possibility to choose a workplace, not whether one is 'going to the office or not'.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете, свързани с „От вкъщи“, са в зелен цвят, а тези, показани за „От офис“, са в син цвят.
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The colors are not mapped to the work location. The green bars correspond to the 'НЕ' (no choice) group, and the blue bars correspond to the 'ДА' (yes choice) group. There is one green and one blue bar for both 'От вкъщи' and 'От офиса'.

errors.text_span: Има два стълба за всеки от категориите: постъпвайки в офис или не.
errors.evidence: The phrasing of this sentence is awkward and confusing, making it difficult to understand the intended meaning.
